entries.068512187267b484: The group has established the 'Morita Philosophy,' which sets out a purpose of 'protecting the lives of people and the planet through technology that supports "peace of mind" and continuous challenge,' and a vision of 'a company that contributes to a safe, livable and prosperous society, and is appreciated and loved.' Under its medium-term management plan 'Morita Reborn 2025,' whose final year was the fiscal year ended March 2026, it has worked to enhance corporate value; the next medium-term management plan is currently being formulated. In addition, at its board of directors meeting held on April 28, 2026, the company resolved to revise its material issues (materialities) in an evolved form.

entries.699b58aec77e3852: In the Fire Vehicles Business, its research and development of fire-fighting drones was selected for a public research program of the Fire and Disaster Management Agency of the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications, and it developed the mass-production model 'EV Pump Unit' of Japan's first EV fire pumper truck, which it presented at INTERSCHUTZ 2026, an international fire and disaster prevention exhibition held in Germany in June 2026.
